transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the Saturday dispatch desk and Sunday communications-log desk roster sorted before the Friday review. I'd like to hear from the motor transport and signal NCOs on whether SPC Jordan, PFC Malik, and SPC Chen are qualified for these posts, and whether there are any qualification-control entries we need to address before I sign off on the final roster.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a qualification issue on my end. SPC Jordan's current dispatch certification is valid for the Saturday 0800-1200 desk — I confirmed his status this morning. However, SPC Chen's replacement certification is still pending in the motor-pool training database, and the database synchronization has not reached battalion personnel yet. So as of right now, from the motor transport perspective, Jordan is qualified for the Saturday dispatch desk, but Chen is not yet showing as qualified for that post.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: From the signal side, I need to flag a qualification issue. PFC Malik's signed communications-log qualification is valid for the Sunday 0800-1200 desk — I received his signed certificate yesterday. However, SPC Chen has not completed the required logkeeping refresher, so Chen is not qualified for the Sunday communications-log post. Also, Malik's scanned certificate has not yet been posted to the personnel folder, so that's a documentation gap we should note for the Friday review.
transcript.speaker: A3
